title: 'Barry Loser' Books Are Becoming a Cartoon
summary:
Barry Loser is a 10-year-old boy with a giant imagination. He is the star of the funny "Barry Loser" books by Jim Smith. Now the books are being turned into a cartoon!

The books have won a prize for funny writing, the Roald Dahl Funny Prize. They have sold more than a million copies and been translated into 17 languages. In the stories, Barry makes a trip to the store or a visit to grandma's feel like a huge adventure.

Two companies, one from the U.K. and one from Italy, are making the show. It will have 52 episodes, and each one will be 11 minutes long. It will look hand-drawn, like the books.

Mark Procter, who leads one of the companies, said the books were his son's favorite. They read them every night.

The team is still raising money. They hope to start making the show in 2027.
why_it_matters: Kids who love the books may soon get to watch Barry's funny adventures on TV.
